en: A black‑and‑white view looking along a curved road with a simple railing, leading through trees towards a tall, cylindrical brick tower with battlements and a steep spire topped by a weather vane. The tower rises above surrounding foliage and a few adjacent buildings partially visible behind the trees. The photograph shows age, dust and scratches, and has no visible printed caption on the front.
